tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
You are organizing a team-building retreat for the whole class. You have found a suitable resort for the event and need to contact the resort manager, Ms. Taylor, to discuss the reservation details.
Write an email to Ms. Taylor. In your email, do the following:
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: Explain the purpose of the retreat and why you chose this particular resort.
Ask about the special dietary options offered.
Inquire about the recreational activities offered at the resort.
tasks.subject: Resort Inquiry
tasks.sample:
Dear Ms. Taylor,



I hope this email finds you well. I am Alfonso, responsible for organizing a class team-building retreat for 35 students and 2 teachers. The retreat aims to enhance class unity and relieve academic pressure, and we chose your resort for its peaceful environment, convenient location, and team-friendly facilities that fit our needs.



I’m writing to inquire about two things. The first one is about special dietary options for students with vegetarian, gluten-free, and dairy-free restrictions. The second one is about on-site recreational activities suitable for our class, such as group games or outdoor spaces. I wonder if your resort can provide these.



Thank you for your time to read this email, and I look forward to hearing from you.



Sincerely,

Alfonso
tasks.title: Write an Email
